name: Kirilllive/tuesday-js
description: Tuesday JS is a free, browser-based visual novel editor using standard HTML5 elements with no dependencies. Supports SVG, GIF animations, CSS styling and exports to desktop and Android.
score_rationale: Accessible no-dependency visual novel tool with 636 stars, actively maintained through 2026 and suitable for web-first interactive fiction projects.
summary: No-dependency HTML5 visual novel editor with desktop and Android export
